items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: On reeds - clarinet is Johnnie Mince, Peanuts Hucko, Mattie Matlock, and Mattie Matlock until his death.

ctx.x: To continue with the artists at the Odessa party, we also had on that same program, on trombones, one that's always with us, the superb Carl Fontana. We had Lou McGarity until his death. And a wonderful Texas trombonist, Ashley Alexander, Jr. We had Ed Hubl on trombone -- another really great unsung hero musically. Let's see, there's myself on drums, and Duke Hanna, and Mousey Alexander, Bobby Rosengarden - that's a motley crew!
On reeds - clarinet is Johnnie Mince, Peanuts
Hucko, Mattie Matlock, and Mattie Matlock until his death.
